proves.claim: with ports.derivedSeatFamily returning a map or a reader, nextSelection.pick passes it to nextFor as derivedSeatFamily and the answer is the port's

moves.selection.derived-seat-family-port.why: Without this test, a regression with a seat-family answer from the port never reaching nextFor would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: with no derivedSeatFamily port, or a port returning null, nextSelection.pick passes no derivedSeatFamily and returns the same item as before

moves.selection.derived-seat-family-port.why: Without this test, a regression with the absent port changing the pick would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: nextSelection.pick reads ports.derivedSeatFamily beside ports.derivedGateAtHead, each answering on its own

moves.selection.derived-seat-family-besi.why: Without this test, a regression with one derived port displacing the other would pass unnoticed.
